statement: `bookings` is a list of [start, end] pairs of integers describing CLOSED intervals [start, end], meaning both endpoints are included. A pair with start > end is invalid and is ignored; start == end is a valid single-point booking. Let A = [a1, a2] and B = [b1, b2] be valid bookings with a1 <= b1. They conflict exactly when b1 <= a2 + 1. So [1, 3] and [3, 5] conflict, [1, 3] and [4, 6] also conflict (no free integer lies between them), but [1, 3] and [5, 7] do not. Return the minimum number of rooms needed so that no two conflicting bookings share a room. Return 0 for an empty list or when every pair is invalid.
